trigger.scope: P0 decomposition of current business processes

rationale: Create a small terminal-only BP extracted from bp_refs_and_submission. It owns submit_and_exit, post-state confirmation, outcome/format guardrails, and stop-after-submit behavior without carrying refs or fraud discovery rules.

dependencies.why: Defines submit_and_exit and the clean terminal behavior this BP describes.

rollback.strategy: Remove the registry row and route final submission checks back through the previous refs/submission unit if terminal-only routing regresses.

retired_reason: post-world-refresh clean competition: prevent resolver fallback to stale historical BP versions while keeping version files in place for future PA-fix history
